newsitem.title: USA: U.S. September S&P 500 futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. September S&P 500 futures end sharply lower.

text.p: U.S. September Standard & Poor's 500 futures closed sharply lower after talk that Japan might sell U.S. Treasuries lifted yields on U.S. government securities, traders and analysts said.
U.S. T-bond futures set fresh lows at the close on a report that Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto suggested that Japan could sell U.S. Treasuries to stabilize the dollar/yen.

The talk filtered into the S&P 500 futures pit where September had just broken through the key psychological support level of 900.00. September S&Ps would fall another 19 points before the end of pit trade.
